title: Sales Representatives of Services, Except Advertising, Insurance, Financial Services, and Travel
description: Sell services to individuals or businesses. May describe options or resolve client problems.

projection.title: Sales representatives of services, except advertising, insurance, financial services, and travel

tasks.text: Consult with clients after sales or contract signings to resolve problems and provide ongoing support.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Product-use advice is largely informational with review

dwas.name: Advise customers on the use of products or services.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Answer customers' questions about services, prices, availability, or credit terms.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Product questions answered from knowledge base

dwas.name: Answer customer questions about goods or services.
dwas.gwa_name: Performing for or Working Directly with the Public

tasks.text: Develop sales presentations or proposals to explain service specifications.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Generates sales content drafts; human tailors and approves

dwas.name: Develop content for sales presentations or other materials.

tasks.text: Create forms or agreements to complete sales.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Draft contracts; legal terms human-owned

tasks.text: Contact prospective or existing customers to discuss how services can meet their needs.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Outreach scripts drafted; live customer contact is human

dwas.name: Contact current or potential customers to promote products or services.

tasks.text: Negotiate prices or terms of sales or service agreements.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Price negotiation needs live give-and-take

dwas.name: Negotiate prices or other sales terms.
dwas.gwa_name: Resolving Conflicts and Negotiating with Others

tasks.text: Quote prices, credit terms, contract terms, or fulfillment dates for services.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Estimates costs/terms; human negotiates and commits

dwas.name: Estimate costs or terms of sales.

tasks.text: Maintain customer records using automated systems.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Maintain structured customer account records

tasks.text: Identify prospective customers using business directories, leads from clients, or information from conferences or trade shows.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — AI analyzes market data to identify prospects

tasks.text: Inform customers of contracts or other information pertaining to purchased services.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Drafts advice; accountability and context owned by human

dwas.name: Advise others on business or operational matters.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Emphasize or recommend service features based on knowledge of customers' needs and vendor capabilities and limitations.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Product recommendations need customer context and persuasion

dwas.name: Explain technical product or service information to customers.
dwas.gwa_name: Interpreting the Meaning of Information for Others

dwas.name: Recommend products or services to customers.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Distribute promotional materials at meetings, conferences, or trade shows.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically distributing samples and literature

dwas.name: Distribute promotional literature or samples to customers.

tasks.text: Monitor market conditions, innovations, and competitors' services, prices, and sales.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — AI extracts product specs and summarizes

dwas.name: Study product information to acquire professional knowledge.

tasks.text: Compute and compare costs of services.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Cost calculation from structured inputs

dwas.name: Assess the cost effectiveness of products, projects, or services.
dwas.gwa_name: Judging the Qualities of Objects, Services, or People

dwas.name: Calculate costs of goods or services.

tasks.text: Attend sales or trade meetings or read related publications to obtain information about market conditions, business trends, regulations, or industry developments.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — AI aggregates and analyzes market data at scale

dwas.name: Attend events to develop professional knowledge.
